rules.rule: One step is open from the task's creation until it is done or cancelled; opening a step closes the one before at the same effective time.
A step's cause and subject are fixed when it opens; a change of credential state with no task event opens no new step.

Within one command a task's open step changes at most once, and every step the command opens or closes shares its effective time. The step closes at an event its closed_by names and the next opens at an event its opened_by names; the opening event is the same as the closing one or later in the command.
Things that do not block the task open no step: a non-blocking question, a cost report and an instant app-run check (L304), and a warn model check (plan RC-16).

opened_by.when: the task is added to Imaginarium
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: the task is promoted to Backlog
a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)

steps.prd_open_while: A planner job is writing the contract.

opened_by.when: a planner claims the task's contract_draft job; queue time stays wait_contract
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: the planner's Complete contract moves the task to Ready
the planner's Complete contract waits on a model check at task.before_ready
the claimed draft job times out
the draft job is withdrawn, by a contract edit
a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)

steps.prd_open_while: The task is in Backlog and nobody is writing its contract.

opened_by.when: the task is added to Backlog
the task is promoted to Backlog
a contract edit returns the task to Backlog (L205)
the claimed draft job times out
the claimed draft job is withdrawn
a contract_incomplete hold opens: a new wait_contract row (L161)
a pending move to Ready is refused or its checks are withdrawn
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: a planner claims the draft job
Complete contract waits on a model check at task.before_ready
a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)
the contract_incomplete hold of this row closes: the step the task's state calls for opens (L277)

steps.prd_open_while: A transition is pending on one or more model checks, or an outward action is waiting on its checks or its approval job.
steps.prd_subject: The pending transition, or the action

opened_by.when: the first model check of a pending transition, or of an outward action at action.requested, is queued (L366)

the action this step is about is approved while a later action still waits on its checks or approval job: the step closes and a new one opens on that action, because a subject is fixed when its step opens (rule 8, L282)
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: the pending move to Ready completes
a gate at task.before_done fails (plan SM-6)
the transition is refused, or its checks are withdrawn, or a provisional claim lapses
the lease ends while the transition is pending
a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)
a contract edit returns the task to Backlog (L205)

steps.prd_open_while: The task is in Ready with no seat. It names `credential_limit` as its cause when no seat is eligible only because none of its candidates is available, and none of them is signed out.

opened_by.when: the task enters Ready
the holder releases the task, or a provisional claim
the builder's lease ends in Working
a failed review sends the task to Ready
an escalation sends the task to Ready
an owner rework sends the task to Ready
a provisional claim lapses: its check failed or erred
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: a provisional claim waits on a model check
a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)
a contract edit returns the task to Backlog (L205)

steps.prd_open_while: A seat has claimed the task and not yet acknowledged the briefing.

opened_by.when: a seat claims the task
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)
a contract edit returns the task to Backlog (L205)

steps.prd_open_while: The builder is working toward a criterion.

opened_by.when: the holder acknowledges after a claim and a builder criterion is still open
the builder announces a criterion: a new build row (plan SM-25)
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: the last builder criterion passes and finish opens
a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)
a contract edit returns the task to Backlog (L205)

steps.prd_open_while: Every builder criterion has passed and the task is not yet submitted, or an approved outward action is being carried out. In the action case it opens when the builder acknowledges the briefing after the approval.
steps.prd_subject: The first approved action not yet reported done, if any

opened_by.when: the last builder criterion passes
the builder acknowledges after an approval (L295), or after a claim with every builder criterion already passed (plan SM-26)
an approved action is reported done and another is still to be carried out: a new finish row for it
a pending submit is refused or its checks are withdrawn
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: the submit waits on a model check at task.before_submit
an approved action is reported done (L306)
a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)
a contract edit returns the task to Backlog (L205)

steps.prd_open_while: The task is submitted and no reviewer has started. It names the provider rule as its cause when that rule refused a reviewer who was otherwise eligible.

opened_by.when: the task is submitted
the reviewer releases the review
the review lease ends
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)
a contract edit returns the task to Backlog (L205)

steps.prd_open_while: A reviewer is checking the work.

opened_by.when: a reviewer claims the review
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: the pass waits on a model check at task.before_done
a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)
a contract edit returns the task to Backlog (L205)

steps.prd_open_while: The task is waiting for its builder after a failed review or an approved action: the builder has a fresh lease and has not yet acknowledged the briefing under it, or an approved action waits for a builder that holds something else.
steps.prd_subject: The review, or the first approved action not yet reported done

opened_by.when: a failed review gives the previous builder a fresh lease (L306)
an approval gives the builder a fresh lease, or leaves the action waiting for a builder that holds something else (L306)
an owner rework gives the previous builder a fresh lease
a waive leaves only approved actions and gives the builder its fresh lease (plan SM-11)
Offer task again, or the last hold lifting while the builder has a fresh lease not yet acknowledged

closed_by.when: the builder acknowledges under the fresh lease: rework or finish opens (L306)
a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)
a contract edit returns the task to Backlog (L205)

steps.prd_open_while: The builder is fixing the work after a failed review, from its acknowledgement of the briefing under the fresh lease until it submits again.

opened_by.when: the builder acknowledges under the fresh lease after a failed review (L306)
the last open hold lifts and the task's state calls for this step (L277)

closed_by.when: the submit waits on a model check
a hold opens on the task: the work or waiting step closes and the hold's step opens (L277)
a contract edit returns the task to Backlog (L205)

steps.prd_open_while: A hold that waits on the owner or the project is open. The table under Holds says which reasons those are.

opened_by.when: a hold whose step is wait_owner opens with no other hold open
an older hold closes and the oldest open hold now has step wait_owner

steps.prd_open_while: The seat holding the task is paused.

opened_by.when: seat_paused opens with no other hold open
an older hold closes and seat_paused is now the oldest

closed_by.when: seat_paused closes: the seat resumes or loses the task (plan SM-15)

steps.prd_open_while: The task is held with `credential_limit`: none of the seat's candidates is available and none is signed out.

opened_by.when: credential_limit opens with no other hold open; hold.opened carries the candidate that resets first (plan SM-41)
an older hold closes and credential_limit is now the oldest

closed_by.when: credential_limit closes: a candidate resets, a reading shows capacity, or the seat loses the task
